materialization.note: DERIVED HERE, and not the THUMBNAIL bundle IRIS generates. These bytes were rendered here from page 1 of 9789240099456-eng.pdf by cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-cover.py (pymupdf 2.0) on 2026-10-30, scaled to 300px wide from a 841.89x595.28pt page. The ORIGINAL is referenced, not held: a GitHub runner (https://github.com/litlfred/who-iris/actions/runs/41121073472) fetched it from https://iris.who.int/items/50d01818-0fa6-43d4-a39e-5bfae735c547, matched it against the sha256 the ORIGINAL bitstream records, rendered this cover and discarded the PDF (who-iris#126). So `gen-covers --check` verifies these bytes, digest and dimensions but cannot re-render them. Region set by eye on the rendering (who-iris#126).
